text:
Maya R: Heads-up — onboarding orca-mini-q2 (int8) canary showing tool-calling parse failures. Failed responses look truncated / missing closing bracket when using streaming + kv-cache. Pasting short log below.

Ben T: Can you paste the raw model output and the funcall schema?

Maya R: sure — here’s the funcall we expect and the broken output we saw.
```
func: create_ticket({
  "title": string,
  "priority": "low|med|high",
  "tags": [string]
})

MODEL OUTPUT (stream chunk end):
{"title": "Payment retry fails for user 12345", "priority": "high", "tags": ["billing", "payments"]

...socket closed...
Traceback: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 96 (char 95)
```

Priya S: this screams tokenization/stream cut at kv-cache boundary. int8 kernels + continuous batching sometimes change emission timing. Try with --no-streaming or disable prefix caching to confirm.

Alex C: also confirm whether the SPM token splitter is inserting sentinel tokens. We saw earlier that a nonprinting sentinel at boundary can cause JSON to drop the last char when reordered.

Ben T: quick repro idea — run the canary with batch_size=1, stream=false, kv_cache=false then compare pass rate. If it passes, it's a streaming/kvcache race.

Maya R: repro run done (small sample 200). Results: stream+kv_cache => 7.5% parse fail. stream only => 6.9%. no-stream,kvcache => 0.5%. no-stream,no-kvcache => 0.3%.

Priya S: interesting — so disabling kvcache drops failures by an order. Likely suffix tokens being popped into cache asynchronously. For short-term mitigation: post-processer to heuristically repair truncated JSON (append closing bracket/brace if missing) and re-parse before triggering retries. Example one-liner we use in other canaries: 
```bash
python - <<'PY'
import sys,json,re
r=sys.stdin.read()
if r.strip().endswith(']') or r.strip().endswith('}'): print(r); sys.exit(0)
# naive closer
if r.count('{')>r.count('}'): r += '}'
if r.count('[')>r.count(']'): r += ']'
print(r)
PY
```
(not perfect but reduces immediate customer errors while we root-cause)

Ben T: +1 for mitigation. But we need a permanent fix: instrument emitter path to ensure streaming flush emits a final sentinel CR before socket close. Also add a canary that runs with kv_cache=true under high qps to replicate.

Alex C: deploy-bot: canary details?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy orca-mini-q2-int8/2026-03-20T15:40Z — traffic routed 2% -> canary pool(4 gpus). Logs retained for 72h.

Maya R: action items: 1) Priya to land post-process heuristic in gateway (short term). 2) Ben to add emitter guard + sentinel flush. 3) Alex + Maya to run larger repro (1k examples) and produce pass/fail delta vs float baseline.

Priya S: I’ll open the PR with the heuristic + unit tests. Will also add test case with trailing CRLF-split chunk.

Ben T: I’ll instrument emitter and add a debug flag to record last 256 bytes before socket close.

Alex C: I’ll kick off 1k eval tomorrow and tag results here. If regressions persist after emitter guard, we should consider a short rollback of int8 canary until we fix. :warning:

Maya R: thanks — team sync in 30m to decide rollback threshold. :thumbsup:
